svg.title: OpenAct roadmap
svg.desc: Shipped in 1.0: Six judgement nodes; Rules, labels and payloads from CSV; Answers saved in the .blend. Next: Lists from geometry inside the tree; On the Blender Extensions platform. Later: A CPU backend, no NVIDIA GPU needed; High-accuracy mode with SemIf's 27B model. Exploring: Agents: decisions during playback; Apple Silicon.
